verdict.rationale: Fireflies documents a broad GraphQL API covering transcript queries and search, audio upload, analytics, active meetings, audit events, webhooks, and introspection. Its MCP tools add write actions such as sharing meetings, moving them to channels, and creating soundbites. However, the API is described as covering "various functionalities," not every UI action, so full UI parity is not shown. missing for 10: any explicit API-UI parity claim; documented API control of the Rules Engine, workspace/admin settings, bot auto-join and calendar configuration, and real-time notes; independent hands-on confirmation of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Our API covers various functionalities, including queries for fetching data as well as uploading meeting audio.
The analytics query fetches detailed conversation and meeting metrics for teams and users across a specified date range.
